scope_statement: 本certは在庫表の追補であり判定欄を持たない. 棄却・生存・EMPTYの語をいかなる行にも使用していない(S-BU-10準拠). kill/候補発見/EMPTY-THMのいずれにも使用しない. p=3のdim3/4のみを対象とし, dim>=5および非中心層には言及しない.

paper_prediction_cross_check.source: docs/notes/w6_bottomup_design_v3.md SS7.2.1 Lemma F3S3 (implementer's hand-derived Krull-Schmidt count from the 6-indecomposable list, computed BEFORE running the enumeration)
paper_prediction_cross_check.caveat: 紙の予言とGAP列挙は同じ実装者による二段階(手計算->コード)であり, CV-9非当事者判読を経ていない. cross-checkedとは書かない(design v3 SS7.2.1と同じ規律) -- 「二系統の第1歩」までである.

conventions_used.generators: theta=(1,2), tau=(1,3,4) in S4 (matches A-0/design v2 SS2.1, v1 census cert)
conventions_used.S3_presentation: <a,b|a^2,b^3,(ab)^2>, a,b = images of theta,tau under S4->S3=S4/V4 (matches A-13/v1 census cert construction)
conventions_used.cohomology_tool: GAP package cohomolo (CHR/FirstCohomologyDimension/SecondCohomologyDimension), external-binary-backed. Not cross-checked by a second implementation in this pass (single-lane; not upgraded to cross-checked status).
conventions_used.p3_building_blocks: triv (dim1), sgn (dim1), U1='1|sgn' (dim2, nonsplit ext sub=sgn/quot=triv), U2='sgn|1' (dim2, nonsplit ext sub=triv/quot=sgn), P1=P(triv)='1|sgn|1' (dim3, uniserial), P2=P(sgn)='sgn|1|sgn' (dim3, uniserial, =P1 tensor sgn) -- per Lemma F3S3, design v3 SS7.2.1. Matrices hand-derived by the implementer solving the extension cocycle conditions for the S3 presentation, verified in-script (a^2=I,b^3=I,(ab)^2=I for each block) before use.
conventions_used.enumeration_method: exhaustive nested loop over 6 nonneg multiplicities (one per block) bounded by [0..dim], filtered by weighted-sum=dim (weights = block dims); this is a CONSTRUCTIVE closed-form enumeration (not brute-force GL(dim,3)-conjugacy search, which would be infeasible for dim=4 since |GL(4,3)|=24261120). Differs from v1's p=3 dim=2 method (brute-force GL(2,3) search, done before Lemma F3S3 existed).
